items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Judge Farnas said, how much y'all charge to play a dance?

ctx.x: Yeah, it was a very small town.

And Buster Millier was a guy that looked like Gilbert Young, but he played like Sun Johnson. And his daddy used to be the pool walker at the Crowley Social Hall, and he'd come around there that night and all we could do was tell us not to go there. You see we used to go there and get liquor, you know, that used to handle that sheriffs and things, they used to handle all that bad liquor. You understand? And we left there and a couple of days after that we had a date in Church Point. We played a wedding out there,…
But you didn't tell me what happened to Evanne.
